## Definition of done

As in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/actuallyrisk/r15k-arcade/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#definition-of-done):

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes with zero errors and zero warnings
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests (unit, replay or pixel snapshot)
- [ ] Screenshots at all reference viewports are attached
- [ ] README and decision records are updated where needed
- [ ] Replays or pixel goldens that were re-recorded are listed and explained (if any)
